parameters.query:
SELECT 
  q.id AS question_id,
  q.question,
  q.date,
  q.temperature,
  q.max_tokens,
  r.id AS reponse_id,
  r.reponse,
  r.provider
FROM question q
LEFT JOIN reponse r ON q.id = r.question_id
ORDER BY q.date DESC, r.provider
LIMIT 40;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS total_questions,
  COUNT(r.id) AS total_responses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.provider) AS unique_providers
FROM question q
LEFT JOIN reponse r ON q.id = r.question_id;

parameters.content:
## Dashboard historique
Accédez à : GET /webhook/history

Retourne une page HTML avec :
- Toutes les questions (10 dernières)
- Réponses de chaque provider
- Statistiques globales

💡 Utilisable comme endpoint REST par une app frontend
